overview.text: Lana Negrete is a Santa Monica City Councilmember appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022. She served as mayor in 2025. In her 2026 candidate statement, she says she is a renter and small business owner. She says she focuses on public safety, homelessness, and small businesses. She opposed a transit-oriented development bill signed into law by Governor Gavin Newsom. She says she pushed for a pending agreement for Santa Monica police to patrol Metro E Line stations. She proposed a city portal to help businesses recover from crime. She opposed a council rule change that would have required co-sponsors for agenda items, saying the council should allow independent voices to bring items forward.
